Priya: quick proposal 1: switch deploybot default from immediate hard-pin to a soft-pin flow for SDK/runtime signature mismatches during low-traffic windows. intent: reduce perf cliffs for large-sequence workloads. cc @Avi @sre-oncall

deploybot: Detected signature mismatch -> sdk=2.9 runtime=3.0. Default action: pin-4156789012 queued.

Avi: sounds good. what's the soft-pin flow? do we add a header or an explicit fallback route?

Priya: flow: 1) mark 1% of traffic with header `X-Compat: soft` 2) SDK returns `compat_estimate` in handshake 3) if >=0.85 keep routing to new runtime, if <0.85 route to regional-fallback, only hard-pin after 15m sustained errors.

sre-oncall: please add clear rollback thresholds and a deadman. i propose: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 2x baseline for 10m -> immediate pin and notify pager. rollback cmd: `deployctl pin --runtime=2.9 --reason="softpin-fail-4156789012"`

Priya: agreed. adding deadman_minutes=20 and a manual kill-switch flag in deploybot console. i'll open PRs for SDK handshake and deploybot flag.

deploybot: Canary scheduled: softpin-4156789012 -> 1% eu-west at 23:40 UTC. logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/softpin-4156789012

Avi: can we have deploybot emit structured `softpin.event` with canary id and compat_estimate? helps postmortem and dashboards.

release-docs-bot: will add a checklist entry to release notes with the runbook and commands: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/820

Priya: launching in 5. i'll post results back here. if green after 90m we plan a controlled lift of the pin and 10% ramp over 6h.
